name: 玩具工作台
prompt:
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. Use case: ui-mockup. This is an image-only visual proposal for the existing Chinese landscape mobile game Fake Bomb It, not a marketing poster or implemented app.
TARGET: a 2160 by 1440 landscape presentation image, containing ONE coherent visual direction with SIX carefully designed complete landscape game screenshots in a strict two-column by three-row grid. Left column light mode, right column dark mode; rows are MENU, IN-GAME, SETTINGS. Each screen is a wide landscape touch game composition at approximately 3:1 aspect ratio, reflecting a 751x247 mobile viewport. No portrait phone. Each screenshot fully fits; aligned thin gutters; simple off-white presentation background, small labels outside the screens "浅色" and "深色", and row labels "菜单", "对局", "设置". A restrained title at top "Fake Bomb It". Do not add concept numbers or options. All six screenshots belong to the same concept, not six competing ideas.
REFERENCES: Image 1 and Image 2 are actual existing dark and light mobile game screenshots, attached as semantic and content references. Preserve their gameplay objects, whole rectangular arena, independent character skins and four-actor identity. The current plain UI is to be upgraded, not copied pixel-for-pixel. User confirmed rounded arcade-game styling that works with both candy and toy-factory map themes. Two themes: 糖果乐园 and 玩具工厂. Two independently chosen skins: mint-green rabbit 薄荷兔 and coral robot 珊瑚机甲. Existing shape language has cream wafers, pink marshmallow walls, toy blocks, cute small characters. Redesign with coherent friendly toy-like dimension, clear type, rounded tactile controls, restrained offset soft shadows, no decorative glass, no web-dashboard framing.
LIGHT/DARK: light uses warm ivory backgrounds, deep teal legible text, mint controls and restrained peach accents. Dark is a real thoughtfully authored moonlit visual variant: midnight blue/teal surfaces, high contrast ivory text, subdued darker candy/wood ground and walls, same recognizable terrain geometry, bright readable danger and items. Dark mode changes map floor, walls and destructible crates too, not just outer chrome; characters retain original skin colors. No generic white map in dark mode.
MENU CONTENT: real game logo Fake Bomb It, choose 糖果乐园 / 玩具工厂 using recognizable mini arena previews, choose 薄荷兔 / 珊瑚机甲 with actual cute rabbit/robot appearance. One dominant "开始游戏" action; supporting settings gear and a sun/moon control. No accounts, currencies, levels, ranking, multiplayer or invented commercial copy.
GAME CONTENT: exact full 17 columns by 15 rows top-down rectangular arena, border walls and alternating solid pillars, breakable wafers/wood crates, readable open paths, four tiny actors. Never crop the arena. Keep arena as the central visual anchor. On left two compact player status rows 玩家 and AI 1, on right AI 2 and AI 3, portraits and concise current bomb occupancy/capacity, range, speed. Identity colors match subtle rings under actors; no names over sprites. 02:00 timer. Left large four-direction thumb joystick, right equally accessible round "放弹" control near outer safe edges. A top-right single five-icon row: pause, fullscreen, settings, sun/moon, layers; consistent stroked icons. Do not overlap board, status rows, or thumb controls. Input controls are for landscape phone use, not desktop keyboard art.
SETTINGS CONTENT: game paused behind or beside the settings surface. Must show real controls with readable Chinese: "设置", "操作", "固定摇杆", "浮动摇杆", "摇杆距左", "摇杆距底", "放弹距右", "放弹距底", a position preview, "恢复操作默认值" and "完成". Distances are from the control OUTER edge to screen safe boundary, horizontal and bottom independently. Display sample values 12 / 8 / 12 / 8 px. One settings screen uses 固定摇杆 selected with all four sliders enabled; its dark counterpart shows 浮动摇杆 selected with only first two sliders disabled gray (retaining their values) and bomb sliders active. Explain in compact human copy "左侧按下出现，松手隐藏". Show volume and particle controls subordinately without crowding. Settings allow manual resume after closing; do not add automatic-resume language. Buttons retain >44px target logic. No sensitivity, size, shake, vibration or other unrequested settings.
Typography: friendly rounded display lettering and crisp readable Chinese UI. No tiny dense paragraphs. No fake code or annotation arrows inside the actual UI. Screen composition, not poster illustration; no device bezels, browser chrome, OS status bar, notch, home indicator, or perspective device mockup. Current date anchor 2026-10-20; no calendar needed. Fidelity high enough to guide semantic responsive implementation; high clarity all rows.

DIRECTION NAME 玩具工作台. This ONE direction is a compact, coherent tabletop arcade system with softly rounded stacked-plastic construction and a mint/ivory/coral day world and midnight-teal night world. MENU: game wordmark and small selected rabbit portrait in a compact left identity column; theme selection reads as an expansive illustrated two-stop horizontal strip across the center, skin choice as a short right portrait rail, large start action aligned bottom right. GAME: maintain full-height rectangular 17x15 arena in the center and two actors on each side, use thin integrated status shelves rather than large enclosing cards, round thumb controls anchored at lower corners and five utility icons on the top right. SETTINGS: a full-width settings workbench with a slim left category column "操作" and "声音 / 画面", middle four large distance rows and fixed/floating toggle, right meaningful position preview with safe-area outline and the two real controls. Short, wide geometry fits the landscape screen. Group using spacing and dividers, with only one softly raised settings surface, no nested cards. Keep all six scenes recognizably the same family and all essential sliders readable.
